name: threat_intel
description: One-call aggregated threat intelligence: give it an IP address or domain and it queries Shodan (exposed services/ports), VirusTotal (reputation), and the NVD CVE database (known vulnerabilities for services found on that host) together, and returns one synthesized verdict instead of you having to call shodan_search, virustotal, and cve_lookup separately and merge them yourself. Use this for 'is this host risky' style questions instead of chaining the individual skills manually.

target.description: An IP address or domain to investigate.
